description:
Found this lamp for $8 at the thrift and instantly fell in love with everything except the shade color. The shape and pleats were too good to pass up, so I grabbed 2 yards of fabric, some spray glue, and got to work.

Quick tip if you try this. Skip the card. Scissors are way easier for getting fabric tucked into the pleats. And definitely choose a busy fabric. You may need to cut as you go, and the pattern hides seams beautifully.

This is hands down one of my favorite thrift flips I’ve done.

✨
